notes: Loaded from Wikipedia (1954 Grand Prix motorcycle racing season, with the Grand Prix report articles that exist, otherwise its standings matrix alone); 8 championship Rounds plus the Ulster Grand Prix, whose 500cc race did not count and which stays in the numbering as a Non-championship round (Round 3), so the Rounds are numbered 1 to 9. Counting window: best 5 of Rounds 1-9. The source names no Team, and gives one machine per Rider, not per Round: the Manufacturer of every Result is the first bike named for him in the standings matrix, or the bike of the report where one exists. Needs a hand check against motogp.com.

rounds.name: Ulster Grand Prix
rounds.notes: The 500cc race was stopped by bad weather and the FIM excluded it from the World Championship (the 1954 season article): no points were awarded. The Round keeps number 3, so the later Rounds are numbered 4 to 9. The race was held: its Session has the winner, the only Result on Wikipedia (the season article's calendar; no report article exists).

sessions.notes: Only the winner is recorded: Wikipedia has no report article for this race and its season article's calendar names the 500cc winner alone. The race scored no points.
